description: Authentication between system components before communication is not implemented. This signal indicates that compromised components may communicate with other systems without verification.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments with inter-system communications. Includes service-to-service authentication, mutual TLS, and component identity verification.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through inter-service communication review, mTLS verification, and component identity assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
